description: Current Singapore source assessment; research only, no runtime source enabled.

dataset.title: SLA Cadastral Land Parcel (2026)
dataset.description: National cadastral polygons for surveyed land parcels/lots; approximate coordinated boundaries (nearest cm). Data from Nov 2025; updated weekly, most recently 28 Sep 2026 per the official page.
dataset.format: GeoJSON full dataset download, about 138.1 MB per current page (previous local research saw 144,795,983 bytes).
dataset.license: Official page says free forever for personal or commercial use under the Open Data Licence.
dataset.sampleStableId: LOT_KEY (from existing local sample record; official page attribute legend also shows LOT_KEY as text).

apiAssessment.downloadFilters: Official download guide describes optional column/row filters (EQ, LIKE, ILIKE); no geometry/bbox/spatial filter is documented for this GeoJSON dataset.
apiAssessment.viewportQuery: No official public SLA/data.gov.sg ArcGIS FeatureServer or WFS viewport query for the full cadastral parcel dataset was found in this bounded search.
apiAssessment.oneMap: SLA OneMap is authoritative and offers interactive LandQuery for a clicked location or entered lot; the official page describes ownership/tenure lookup and weekly updates, not a public bulk parcel-geometry bbox endpoint.
apiAssessment.currentConnectivity: Browser sources read successfully. Direct requests to data.gov.sg v2 metadata and poll-download endpoints returned HTTP 403 from this environment; no current presigned URL/download was fetched. Existing local evidence from 2026-09-29 records poll-download returning a short-lived URL and an HTTP 206 range read of 14 KB (16 features) from a 144,795,983-byte GeoJSON snapshot.
apiAssessment.recommendation: Treat as an authoritative weekly refreshed national snapshot for server-side ingest into a spatial index, then serve local viewport queries. It is not currently a direct live viewport source based on published APIs found. Recheck SLA/OneMap developer documentation or contact SLA if a live service is required.
